warnings.head: THIRD CATEGORY WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS
warnings.text: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) WARNING ON SEA LEVEL RISE Sea level rise is expected over the waters of East Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan until Sunday, 22 November 2026. At risk of inundation of seawater over the coast. 2) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perlis & Kedah • Selangor • N. Sembilan • East Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan • Western Sabah • Eastern Sabah until 6:00 PM; Saturday, 21 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) WARNING ON STRONG
